invoices.note: Reference invoice content shared identically between the XML and PDF members of a ZIP.

note: ZIP with invoice.xml and invoice.pdf representing the SAME invoice (same serial/number/lines/totals); parser should not double-count this as two invoices if it dedupes, or should report two parse results with identical business content. App design: when a ZIP holds an invoice XML, only the XML is used (no double booking); non-invoice XML is skipped.
